import json, subprocess, sys, copy

MAIN = "/work/submission/main.py"

def run(doc, raw=None):
    if raw is None:
        raw = json.dumps(doc).encode()
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", MAIN], input=raw, capture_output=True)
    return p.returncode, p.stdout, p.stderr

def check(name, doc, expect=None, raw=None, expect_invalid=False):
    rc, out, err = run(doc, raw)
    if expect_invalid:
        ok = (rc == 2)
        try:
            j = json.loads(out)
            ok = ok and j == {"error": "invalid-input"}
        except Exception:
            ok = False
        print(("PASS " if ok else "FAIL ") + name, "" if ok else ("rc=%r out=%r err=%r" % (rc, out[:300], err[:300])))
        return
    ok = (rc == 0)
    try:
        got = json.loads(out)
    except Exception as e:
        print("FAIL " + name, "unparseable", out[:300], err[:300]); return
    if expect is not None:
        for path, val in expect.items():
            cur = got
            ok = True
            for k in path.split("."):
                if isinstance(k, int):
                    cur = cur[k]
                else:
                    if k not in cur: cur = None; break
                    cur = cur[k]
            if cur != val:
                ok = False
                print("   MISMATCH", name, path, "got", repr(cur), "want", repr(val))
                break
    print(("PASS " if ok else "FAIL ") + name)
    if not ok:
        print(json.dumps(got, indent=1, sort_keys=True))

# ---------------- test 1: simple chain ----------------
t1 = {"version":1,"n":3,"capacity":[2,2,2],
 "edges":[{"u":0,"v":1,"ping_us":1,"ack_us":1,"label":"a"},
          {"u":1,"v":2,"ping_us":1,"ack_us":1,"label":"b"}],
 "rounds":[{"launch_us":0,"timeout_us":10,"host_delay_us":1,"drop_host_ack":False,"drop_ping":[],"drop_ack":[]}]}
check("t1 chain", t1, {
 "rounds.0.started": True, "rounds.0.source_final_us": 4, "rounds.0.source_complete": True,
 "rounds.0.host_delivery_us": 5, "rounds.0.source_proof":[0,1],
 "metrics.host_probe_tx":1, "metrics.network_ping_tx":2, "metrics.network_ack_tx":2,
 "metrics.host_ack_tx":1, "metrics.deduplicated_ping":0, "metrics.capacity_drops":0,
 "metrics.late_ping":0, "metrics.ignored_ack":0, "metrics.allocations":3,
 "metrics.cache_peak":[1,1,1], "metrics.peak_entries":3, "metrics.end_us":11,
 "classes.0.signature":["a","b"], "classes.0.candidate_count":1, "classes.0.evidence_rounds":[0],
 "classes.0.state":"unique", "classes.0.candidate_witnesses":[[0,1]],
 "summary.topology_paths":1, "summary.observable_classes":1, "summary.observed_classes":1,
 "summary.unique_observed_classes":1, "summary.ambiguous_observed_classes":0,
 "summary.path_evidence_lower":1, "summary.path_evidence_upper":1, "summary.coverage_status":"complete"})

# ---------------- test 2: no route ----------------
t2 = {"version":1,"n":3,"capacity":[2,2,2],
 "edges":[{"u":1,"v":2,"ping_us":1,"ack_us":1,"label":"a"}],
 "rounds":[{"launch_us":0,"timeout_us":10,"host_delay_us":1,"drop_host_ack":False,"drop_ping":[],"drop_ack":[]}]}
check("t2 no route", t2, {
 "rounds.0.started": True, "rounds.0.source_final_us": 0, "rounds.0.source_complete": True,
 "rounds.0.host_delivery_us": 1, "rounds.0.source_proof":[],
 "metrics.network_ping_tx":0, "metrics.network_ack_tx":0, "metrics.allocations":1,
 "metrics.end_us":11,
 "classes":[], "summary.topology_paths":0, "summary.observable_classes":0,
 "summary.observed_classes":0, "summary.coverage_status":"no-routes"})

# ---------------- test 3: capacity 0 at source ----------------
t3 = copy.deepcopy(t1); t3["capacity"][0] = 0
check("t3 cap0 source", t3, {
 "rounds.0.started": False, "rounds.0.source_final_us": None, "rounds.0.source_complete": None,
 "rounds.0.host_delivery_us": None, "rounds.0.source_proof":[],
 "metrics.capacity_drops":1, "metrics.allocations":0, "metrics.host_ack_tx":0,
 "metrics.cache_peak":[0,0,0], "metrics.peak_entries":0, "metrics.end_us":11,
 "classes.0.evidence_rounds":[], "classes.0.state":"unobserved",
 "summary.observed_classes":0, "summary.coverage_status":"no-evidence",
 "summary.path_evidence_upper":0})

# ---------------- test 4: late ping ----------------
t4 = {"version":1,"n":3,"capacity":[2,2,2],
 "edges":[{"u":0,"v":1,"ping_us":20,"ack_us":1,"label":"a"},
          {"u":1,"v":2,"ping_us":1,"ack_us":1,"label":"b"}],
 "rounds":[{"launch_us":0,"timeout_us":10,"host_delay_us":1,"drop_host_ack":False,"drop_ping":[],"drop_ack":[]}]}
check("t4 late ping", t4, {
 "rounds.0.started": True, "rounds.0.source_final_us": 10, "rounds.0.source_complete": False,
 "rounds.0.host_delivery_us": 11, "rounds.0.source_proof":[],
 "metrics.network_ping_tx":1, "metrics.network_ack_tx":0, "metrics.late_ping":1,
 "metrics.allocations":1, "metrics.ignored_ack":0, "metrics.end_us":11,
 "classes.0.evidence_rounds":[], "classes.0.state":"unobserved"})

# ---------------- test 5: drop host ack ----------------
t5 = copy.deepcopy(t1); t5["rounds"][0]["drop_host_ack"] = True
check("t5 drop host ack", t5, {
 "rounds.0.started": True, "rounds.0.source_final_us": 4, "rounds.0.source_complete": True,
 "rounds.0.host_delivery_us": None, "rounds.0.source_proof":[0,1],
 "metrics.host_ack_tx":1, "metrics.end_us":11,
 "classes.0.evidence_rounds":[], "classes.0.state":"unobserved",
 "summary.observed_classes":0, "summary.coverage_status":"no-evidence"})

# ---------------- test 6: alias labels (ambiguity) ----------------
t6 = {"version":1,"n":3,"capacity":[2,2,2],
 "edges":[{"u":0,"v":1,"ping_us":1,"ack_us":1,"label":"a"},
          {"u":1,"v":2,"ping_us":1,"ack_us":1,"label":"x"}],
 "rounds":[{"launch_us":0,"timeout_us":10,"host_delay_us":1,"drop_host_ack":False,"drop_ping":[],"drop_ack":[]}]}
# single path -> unique
check("t6 single", t6, {"classes.0.state":"unique"})

# ---------------- test 7: two paths same signature ----------------
t7 = {"version":1,"n":4,"capacity":[4,4,4,4],
 "edges":[{"u":0,"v":1,"ping_us":1,"ack_us":1,"label":"a"},
          {"u":0,"v":2,"ping_us":1,"ack_us":1,"label":"a"},
          {"u":1,"v":3,"ping_us":1,"ack_us":1,"label":"b"},
          {"u":2,"v":3,"ping_us":1,"ack_us":1,"label":"b"}],
 "rounds":[{"launch_us":0,"timeout_us":20,"host_delay_us":1,"drop_host_ack":False,"drop_ping":[],"drop_ack":[]}]}
check("t7 alias ambiguous", t7, {
 "metrics.deduplicated_ping":1, "metrics.allocations":4, "metrics.network_ping_tx":5,
 "metrics.network_ack_tx":4,
 "classes.0.signature":["a","b"], "classes.0.candidate_count":2, "classes.0.evidence_rounds":[0],
 "classes.0.state":"ambiguous",
 "summary.topology_paths":2, "summary.observable_classes":1, "summary.observed_classes":1,
 "summary.ambiguous_observed_classes":1, "summary.path_evidence_lower":1,
 "summary.path_evidence_upper":2, "summary.coverage_status":"complete"})

# ---------------- test 8: dead end ----------------
t8 = {"version":1,"n":4,"capacity":[4,4,4,4],
 "edges":[{"u":0,"v":1,"ping_us":1,"ack_us":1,"label":"a"},
          {"u":0,"v":2,"ping_us":1,"ack_us":1,"label":"b"},
          {"u":1,"v":2,"ping_us":1,"ack_us":1,"label":"c"}],
 "rounds":[{"launch_us":0,"timeout_us":20,"host_delay_us":1,"drop_host_ack":False,"drop_ping":[],"drop_ack":[]}]}
# node 2 is a dead end (n-1=3 unreachable). Path 0->1->2 exists.
check("t8 dead end", t8, {
 "classes.0.signature":["a","c"], "classes.0.candidate_count":1, "classes.0.state":"unique",
 "summary.topology_paths":1})

# ---------------- test 9: empty rounds ----------------
t9 = copy.deepcopy(t1); t9["rounds"] = []
check("t9 empty rounds", t9, {
 "rounds":[], "metrics.end_us":0, "metrics.host_probe_tx":0,
 "metrics.cache_peak":[0,0,0], "metrics.peak_entries":0,
 "classes.0.evidence_rounds":[], "classes.0.state":"unobserved",
 "summary.observed_classes":0, "summary.coverage_status":"no-evidence"})

# ---------------- test 10: two rounds, staggered launch ----------------
t10 = {"version":1,"n":3,"capacity":[4,4,4],
 "edges":[{"u":0,"v":1,"ping_us":1,"ack_us":1,"label":"a"},
          {"u":1,"v":2,"ping_us":1,"ack_us":1,"label":"b"}],
 "rounds":[{"launch_us":100,"timeout_us":10,"host_delay_us":2,"drop_host_ack":False,"drop_ping":[],"drop_ack":[]},
            {"launch_us":0,"timeout_us":10,"host_delay_us":1,"drop_host_ack":False,"drop_ping":[],"drop_ack":[]}]}
check("t10 staggered", t10, {
 "rounds.0.source_final_us":104, "rounds.0.host_delivery_us":106,
 "rounds.1.source_final_us":4, "rounds.1.host_delivery_us":5,
 "metrics.end_us":111})
PYEOF
cd /work && python3 /work/tmp/tests/run_tests.py
